fields.description: A name for you, such as the restaurant brand.
fields.label: Connection Name

fields.description: Every document made from this connection is booked in this Company.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Test the connection first. While off, webhooks are refused and the feed is not read.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Read Only: the app only reads from Koomyo and never writes to it (no suppliers, Purchase Orders, receipts, ingredient costs or ERPNext ids). Read and Write also sends what is made in ERPNext.
fields.label: Koomyo Access

fields.description: Check every event against the maps and ERPNext rules, but save nothing. The Event Log says what would have been made.
fields.label: Dry Run
Status
fields.options:
Not Tested
Connected
Needs Attention
Needs Re-sync

fields.description: Ends with /api/public/v1. Change it only for a self-hosted or regional Koomyo.
fields.label: API Address

fields.description: From Koomyo Settings > Integrations > API keys (starts with kyo_live_).
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Events before this date are not read from the feed. Bring older data in with a backfill.
fields.label: Start From Date

fields.description: The system name under which this ERPNext's ids are stored in Koomyo's external references. Give each connection to the same Koomyo restaurant its own name.
fields.label: External Reference Name

fields.description: Each Koomyo branch maps to a Cost Center and Warehouse of this connection's Company; each Koomyo central warehouse to a Warehouse.
fields.label: Branches

fields.description: Koomyo sends one tax amount and rate per order, and whether prices include tax. Map each rate to a tax account. The most exact row wins: branch and rate, then rate, then branch, then an empty row.
fields.label: Taxes

fields.description: order.paid becomes a submitted Sales Invoice with one Payment Entry per payment.
fields.label: Sync Sales

fields.description: refund.created becomes a Credit Note against the order's Sales Invoice, with its payment out.
fields.label: Sync Refunds

fields.description: Koomyo sends a refund amount without lines. Proportional reverses revenue and taxes in the same share, exact to the cent. Full refunds always mirror the invoice.
fields.label: Partial Refunds
fields.options:
Leave for Manual Booking
Proportional Credit Note

fields.description: Koomyo menu items are created here as non-stock Items the first time they are sold.
fields.label: Menu Item Group

fields.description: Shown on the invoices only; the rates always come from Koomyo.
fields.label: Selling Price List
Cost Center for Records Without a Branch

fields.description: Needed once an order has a delivery fee.
fields.label: Delivery Fee Account

fields.description: Needed once an order has a channel markup (for example Foodpanda).
fields.label: Channel Markup Account

fields.description: Needed once an order has a payment-method discount or surcharge.
fields.label: Payment Method Discount Account

fields.description: Koomyo discounts are posted as a discount on each line (list price, discount, net price). Give each source its own account so promotions, vouchers and staff discounts can be told apart in the books.
fields.label: Discount Accounts

fields.description: shift.closed books the cash over or short as one Journal Entry. The takings and refunds are already in the invoices and credit notes.
fields.label: Sync Shifts

fields.description: Only needed when the cash methods of a shift map to more than one account, or to none.
fields.label: Cash Drawer Account

fields.description: Daily ingredient usage, waste, manual adjustments, stock counts and transfers become Stock Entries and Stock Reconciliations in the mapped Warehouses.
fields.label: Sync Stock

fields.description: Stock events dated before this day are skipped: they are already in the Warehouses' opening stock. Set it to the day after your opening stock was entered, so stock is never counted twice.
fields.label: Opening Stock Date

fields.description: Koomyo ingredients not yet linked to an Item are created here as stock Items.
fields.label: Ingredient Item Group

fields.description: Daily: what sales used comes once a day after the day ends, as one Material Issue per branch. Per Order: each paid order takes out exactly what Koomyo deducted for it, and a cancelled order puts it back.
fields.label: Stock Deduction
fields.options:
Daily (from Koomyo usage)
Per Order (from Koomyo movements)

fields.description: A change takes effect the next day, so no day is counted both ways. Days before keep the old setting.
fields.label: Stock Deduction Applies From
Stock Deduction Before That
fields.options:
Daily (from Koomyo usage)
Per Order (from Koomyo movements)

fields.description: For manual adjustments and stock count differences.
fields.label: Stock Adjustment Account

fields.description: Needed once a transfer arrives with less than was sent.
fields.label: Transfer Loss Account

fields.description: Submitted Purchase Orders and Purchase Receipts for a mapped Warehouse are written to Koomyo (with their Supplier), changed ingredient valuation rates update Koomyo's ingredient cost, and a Koomyo receipt of an ERPNext order becomes a Purchase Receipt.
fields.label: Sync Purchasing

fields.description: A purchase order made in the Koomyo admin becomes a Supplier (if new) and a submitted Purchase Order in ERPNext once it is ordered (drafts create nothing), and each delivery becomes its own Purchase Receipt. Changes and cancellations in Koomyo follow. Orders made in ERPNext are never doubled.
fields.label: Book Orders Made in Koomyo

fields.description: Where Koomyo orders without a branch are received (Koomyo's main warehouse).
fields.label: Main Warehouse

fields.description: Koomyo customers become Customers (name, phone and email only). Needs the webhook's customer data switch on in Koomyo.
fields.label: Sync Customers

fields.description: Give the address to Koomyo when you add the webhook endpoint, and keep it private. Paste the secret Koomyo shows once.
fields.label: Webhook

fields.description: Give this address to Koomyo when you add the webhook endpoint. Keep it private.
fields.label: Webhook Address

fields.description: The whsec_ secret shown once when the webhook endpoint is created in Koomyo.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Use the Load Menu and Ingredients button to make every Koomyo menu item and ingredient an Item now, instead of on first sale or first stock movement. Loading again updates names, categories and active flags; nothing is ever doubled.
fields.label: Menu and Ingredients
Created by Set Up From Koomyo
Created by Set Up From Koomyo

fields.description: Koomyo sends the tax, any withholding and extra charges (delivery, labour) of each order. Map them to accounts so the Purchase Order and Receipt match Koomyo to the cent.
fields.label: Purchase Taxes and Charges

fields.description: Input tax that can be claimed back (not part of what an ingredient costs).
fields.label: Purchase Tax Account

fields.description: Where withholding tax deducted from the supplier's bill is owed. Never part of cost.
fields.label: Withholding Tax Account

fields.description: An account of type Expenses Included In Valuation: tax that cannot be claimed back and charges spread over cost end up in the cost of the goods through it.
fields.label: Landed Cost Account

fields.description: Charges that are not spread over cost (an expense only).
fields.label: Charges Expense Account

fields.description: Follow Koomyo uses each charge's own setting (none, by value, by quantity). The others override it for every charge of the connection.
fields.label: Charges in Landed Cost
fields.options:
Follow Koomyo
None
By Value
By Quantity

fields.description: Stock sent between places waits here until it arrives (ERPNext's Send to Warehouse / Receive at Warehouse). With it, a transfer is posted in steps: sent, each delivery, then returned or lost. Without it, a transfer is posted in one step when it completes.
fields.label: Transit Warehouse
